about.stu_follow_up_ans: It is an application that aims to improve the school work environment, as it allows the school administration to directly monitor the status of the student during school hours, providing a variety of services that help teachers to perform their entrusted tasks to reduce administrative burdens and raise the level of their performance within the classroom, which is reflected positively on the level of achievement The student’s academic studies and reduce the financial burdens on the guardian through private lessons and others. The system also allows providing an innovative mechanism to assess the student’s behavioral and educational level, and a supervisory partnership between the educational institution and the student’s guardian contributes to reducing negative phenomena inside the school building and preparing a generation of young people who are aware of their personality, maker of their identity and contributor to achieving the national vision.
about.sec_of_educational_content: Section of educational content on how to use the system
about.ration_the_Consumption: Rationalizing the consumption of material resources in the educational institution
about.providing_an_easy_and_accurate: Providing an easy and accurate way to record the attendance and absence of students in the classroom
about.providing_accurate_report: Providing accurate reports and continuous follow-up to students by the school administration
about.reducing_negative_phenomena: Reducing negative phenomena inside the school building and enhancing preventive security for students
about.reducing_the_burden_on_teachers: Reducing the burden on teachers charged with administrative supervision and full-time follow-up of students' behavior
about.contribute_to_instilling: Contribute to instilling and strengthening the noble moral values stemming from the teachings of our true Islamic religion and authentic Arab customs.
about.involve_the_gardian: Involve the student's guardian directly and effectively in order to improve the student's educational level
about.means_to_attract: Providing the means to attract qualified faculty and technical staff members in a manner that ensures good investment and directing these elements to serve the education system and its lofty mission in order to develop and develop the educational work
about.contribute_to_pre_young_gen: Contribute to preparing a generation of young people who are aware of their personality, a maker of their identity and a contributor to achieving the national vision
